A reliable partner in health.

Mercari Maior Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a pharmaceutical and medical supplies distribution company dedicated to enhancing health and wellness in the community. Established on October 8, 2024, we are committed to providing high-quality health products that meet the needs of healthcare providers and patients alike.

With a strong focus on regulatory compliance and customer service, we play a vital role in supporting the Philippine healthcare system.

Our mission

To become a trusted provider of pharmaceutical and medical supplies, empowering individuals and healthcare facilities to achieve optimal health outcomes. We strive to be a health warrior, dedicated to improving the quality of life through access to essential health products.

Products and services

Mercari Maior Pharmaceuticals Inc. specializes in the distribution of:

Pharmaceutical products

Health and wellness products

Strict quality assurance

Ensuring all pharmaceutical products meet FDA standards for safety, efficacy, and quality through rigorous sourcing and handling protocols.

Efficient distribution network

Maintaining a reliable logistics system to deliver medicines promptly and securely to healthcare partners across the region.

Regulatory compliance and transparency

Upholding full compliance with national health regulations and maintaining transparency in all business operations.

Strong partner relationships

Building strong relationships with pharmacies, clinics, and hospitals to better understand and meet the evolving needs of the healthcare sector.

Our history

  1. July 2024

    The business was formally registered as Mercari Maior Pharma and Medical Supplies Distribution, a sole proprietorship dedicated to the healthcare sector. Later that year, the company transitioned into a corporation.

  2. October 8, 2024

    Mercari Maior Pharmaceuticals Inc. was officially established, marking a new era with the mission to be a reliable partner in health.

Mercari Maior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a licensed pharmaceutical wholesaler based in Obando, Bulacan. Established in 2024, the company is committed to delivering safe, high-quality, and affordable medicines to healthcare providers across the region. With a strong focus on regulatory compliance and customer service, Mercari Maior plays a vital role in supporting the Philippine healthcare system.
